value: Turn pet photos into portraits worth keeping.

Pettenderly is an online AI pet portrait studio for cat and dog owners. Upload one to five clear photos of the same pet, choose a watercolor, royal or studio style, and download a digital portrait. The Starter Pack is a one-time $4.99 purchase for 12 non-expiring credits. Each successful image uses one credit; failed generations do not use credits. Pro plans provide 40 credits per month. You & your pet and photo cleanup are beta features. Faces, markings and fine details may vary. Digital images only; physical prints are not included.
